normalisation.method: percentile rank against a frozen national reference (scoring/reference_v3.parquet)
normalisation.reference_set: all 28 states plus Delhi and Jammu & Kashmir, latest observation per state
normalisation.direction: +1 = higher is better; -1 = cost or risk, scored as 100 - percentile
normalisation.missing: never filled. Indicator dropped and weights renormalised within the dimension; a dimension with no observed indicator is dropped and dimension weights are renormalised. Both are disclosed per state.

ecosystem.label: Business ecosystem / competition
ecosystem.note: High density can mean a valuable cluster OR a saturated market; scored as cluster depth.

policy.label: Policy & ease of doing business
policy.note: Official government assessments (DPIIT BRAP, LEADS, NITI EPI, DPIIT Startup Ranking). Ordinal categories are scored as ordinal codes, so ties share a percentile; they measure reform implementation and user feedback, not incentives on offer.

domestic_tourist_visits.label: Domestic tourist visits
domestic_tourist_visits.proxy: visits, not unique people or room nights

power_shortage_pct.label: Energy shortage
power_shortage_pct.proxy: state-level shortage, not plant-level outages or tariff
power_shortage_pct.hi: power supply falls short of demand more often
power_shortage_pct.lo: power supply meets demand more reliably

peak_unmet_pct.label: Peak demand not met
peak_unmet_pct.hi: peak demand goes unmet more often

nh_km_per_lakh_pop.label: National highways per lakh people
nh_km_per_lakh_pop.hi: a denser highway network per person
nh_km_per_lakh_pop.lo: a thinner highway network per person

rail_km_per_lakh_pop.label: Railway route per lakh people
rail_km_per_lakh_pop.hi: a denser rail network per person
rail_km_per_lakh_pop.lo: a thinner rail network per person

forecast_manufacturing.label: Forecast: manufacturing real GSVA growth next FY

ur_urban_us_adj.label: Urban unemployment rate (labour pool)
ur_urban_us_adj.proxy: higher = larger available pool; shown as supply, not as a negative
ur_urban_us_adj.hi: more urban job-seekers to hire from
ur_urban_us_adj.lo: a tighter urban labour market (more hiring competition)

ur_rural_us_adj.label: Rural unemployment rate (labour pool)
ur_rural_us_adj.hi: more rural job-seekers to hire from

specialists_per_lakh_pop.label: Public-sector specialists in position per lakh

phc_doctors_per_lakh_pop.label: Public PHC doctors in position per lakh

share_manufacturing.label: Manufacturing share of GSVA
share_manufacturing.hi: industry is a bigger part of the economy
share_manufacturing.lo: industry is a smaller part of the economy

govt_beds_per_lakh_pop.label: Public hospital beds per lakh (care gap)
govt_beds_per_lakh_pop.proxy: fewer public beds per person = more patients relying on private care; not private capacity
govt_beds_per_lakh_pop.hi: public hospitals already cover more of the population
govt_beds_per_lakh_pop.lo: a wider public-bed gap for private providers to fill

edu_graduate_plus_pct.label: Graduates among adults (15+)
edu_graduate_plus_pct.proxy: PLFS 2023-24: graduate + post-graduate as highest level completed
edu_graduate_plus_pct.hi: a larger share of graduates in the adult population
edu_graduate_plus_pct.lo: a smaller share of graduates in the adult population

edu_secondary_plus_pct.label: Adults with secondary education or more

edu_diploma_pct.label: Adults with a diploma or certificate
edu_diploma_pct.proxy: PLFS 2023-24: technical / vocational diploma or certificate as highest level

ger_higher_education.label: Higher-education enrolment (GER, ages 18-23)
ger_higher_education.hi: more young people in higher education
ger_higher_education.lo: fewer young people in higher education

graduates_per_lakh_pop.label: New graduates a year per lakh people
graduates_per_lakh_pop.proxy: AISHE 2023-24 UG + PG pass-outs by state of institution; responding institutions only
graduates_per_lakh_pop.hi: a larger annual pipeline of fresh graduates
graduates_per_lakh_pop.lo: a smaller annual pipeline of fresh graduates

brap_2024_category.label: Ease of doing business: BRAP 2024 category
brap_2024_category.proxy: DPIIT assessment (70% user feedback, 30% evidence); ordinal

brap_2024_top_achiever_areas.label: Reform areas rated Top Achiever (BRAP 2024)
brap_2024_top_achiever_areas.proxy: count of the 25 BRAP reform areas with a score above 90%
brap_2024_top_achiever_areas.hi: more business-reform areas rated Top Achiever
brap_2024_top_achiever_areas.lo: fewer business-reform areas rated Top Achiever

leads_2025_tier.label: Logistics ease: LEADS 2025 tier
leads_2025_tier.proxy: Ministry of Commerce assessment; tiers assigned within peer groups; ordinal

epi_2024_score.label: Export Preparedness Index 2024
epi_2024_score.proxy: NITI Aayog composite incl. policy & governance; overlaps infrastructure indicators

why.gsdp_rs_crore: A large state economy puts buyers and suppliers within reach of the plant.
why.per_capita_nsdp_real: Higher incomes support regional demand for manufactured goods.
why.exports_usd_mn: An export base signals port links, compliance know-how and overseas buyers.
why.power_shortage_pct: Production lines stop when power falls short; supply reliability protects output.
why.peak_unmet_pct: Peak-hour shortfalls hit multi-shift operations hardest.
why.per_capita_power_availability: Ample power per person indicates grid headroom for industrial loads.
why.nh_km_per_lakh_pop: Highways carry inbound inputs and outbound finished goods.
why.rail_km_per_lakh_pop: Rail moves bulk raw materials and long-haul freight cheaply.
why.forecast_manufacturing: The validated model's view of next year's manufacturing growth in the state.
why.momentum_manufacturing: Recent manufacturing growth shows whether the state's industrial base is expanding.
why.asi_workers: An existing factory workforce shortens hiring and training time.
why.ur_urban_us_adj: Supervisors, technicians and office staff are hired from the urban job-seeker pool.
why.ur_rural_us_adj: Shop-floor and contract labour is largely drawn from rural job-seekers.
why.asi_factories: More factories mean suppliers, service vendors and experienced managers nearby.
why.share_manufacturing: Manufacturing-led states tend to have industrial parks, clearances and vendor networks in place.
why.credit_industry_share: Banks used to lending to industry make working capital and term loans easier to raise.
why.rural_wage_nonagri: Non-farm wage levels drive shop-floor labour cost.
why.td_losses_pct: High grid losses push utilities towards higher industrial tariffs.
why.cpi_inflation_general: Faster inflation erodes margins through wage and input costs.
why.edu_diploma_pct: Diploma and ITI-type qualifications supply the technicians and maintenance staff a plant needs.
why.edu_secondary_plus_pct: Shop-floor roles that run machines and follow SOPs usually need secondary schooling.
why.brap_2024_category: A better reform rating means faster approvals, inspections and clearances for a new plant.
why.brap_2024_top_achiever_areas: Top-rated reform areas (e.g. construction permits, land, environment, labour) cut set-up time.
why.epi_2024_score: Export preparedness covers export policy, institutions and trade facilitation that plants rely on.
why.leads_2025_tier: Logistics-policy quality affects inbound inputs and outbound shipments.

retail.label: Retail
retail.target_note: Trade & repair GSVA is not published by state in the RBI handbook; services aggregate is a broad proxy only.

why.mpce_urban: Urban household spending is the most direct measure of the shopper's wallet.
why.per_capita_nsdp_real: Higher incomes mean more discretionary spending per shopper.
why.personal_loans_per_capita: Consumer credit funds big-ticket purchases such as electronics and durables.
why.gsdp_rs_crore: A larger economy means more total consumer spending to capture.
why.internet_subs_per_100: Online adoption supports digital payments and omnichannel selling.
why.power_shortage_pct: Stores need dependable power for lighting, billing and cold storage.
why.nh_km_per_lakh_pop: Highways keep store replenishment fast and cheap.
why.momentum_services: Services growth (a broad proxy that includes trade) signals rising consumer activity.
why.ur_urban_us_adj: Store and front-line staff are hired from the urban job-seeker pool.
why.share_services: A services-led economy has a larger formal, consumer-facing sector.
why.bank_offices_per_lakh_pop: Dense banking access supports card and UPI payments and cash handling.
why.cpi_inflation_housing_urban: Rising urban rents raise store lease costs.
why.cpi_inflation_general: Inflation squeezes shoppers' real spending power.
why.edu_secondary_plus_pct: Billing, inventory and customer-facing staff are usually hired with at least secondary schooling.
why.brap_2024_category: A better reform rating means quicker trade licences, shop registrations and inspections.
why.brap_2024_top_achiever_areas: Top-rated reform areas (e.g. business entry, services sector) shorten store openings.

it_services.label: IT / professional services
it_services.target_note: No state IT/professional-services GSVA; services and financial-services aggregates are broad proxies.

why.gsdp_rs_crore: A larger economy has more enterprises buying IT and professional services.
why.per_capita_nsdp_real: Higher incomes point to a richer corporate and professional client base.
why.internet_subs_per_100_urban: Urban connectivity is essential for delivery centres and hybrid work.
why.internet_subs_per_100: Wide internet adoption supports distributed teams and digital clients.
why.power_shortage_pct: Delivery centres need uninterrupted power to meet uptime commitments.
why.momentum_services: Services growth (a broad proxy) signals rising demand for professional services.
why.momentum_financial_services: Financial-services growth signals demand from BFSI, the largest IT buyer.
why.ur_urban_us_adj: Graduate and entry-level hires come from the urban job-seeker pool.
why.share_services: A services-led economy offers more clients and experienced talent.
why.share_financial_services: A strong financial sector puts BFSI clients close by.
why.cpi_inflation_housing_urban: Rising urban rents raise office and employee housing costs.
why.edu_graduate_plus_pct: IT and professional roles are graduate jobs: the graduate share sizes the hireable pool.
why.graduates_per_lakh_pop: Fresh graduates each year feed entry-level hiring and campus recruitment.
why.ger_higher_education: Higher-education enrolment indicates the size of the future graduate pipeline.
why.startup_ranking_5_category: Startup-policy strength signals support for tech firms, incubation and innovation.
why.brap_2024_category: A better reform rating means quicker registrations, approvals and labour compliance.
why.brap_2024_top_achiever_areas: Top-rated reform areas (e.g. business entry, labour, services) ease setting up offices.

logistics.label: Logistics
logistics.target_note: Transport & storage GSVA is not in the handbook; whole-economy growth is used as momentum context.

why.gsdp_rs_crore: A larger economy generates more freight to move.
why.exports_usd_mn: Exports create port-bound and cross-border freight.
why.nh_km_per_lakh_pop: Highway density sets trucking reach and transit times.
why.rail_km_per_lakh_pop: Rail capacity supports bulk and long-haul container movement.
why.power_shortage_pct: Warehouses and cold chains need reliable power.
why.ur_urban_us_adj: Warehouse, last-mile and office staff are hired from the urban pool.
why.ur_rural_us_adj: Drivers and loaders are often drawn from rural job-seekers.
why.asi_factories: Factories are the main shippers of inbound and outbound freight.
why.credit_industry_share: Industrial lending signals active manufacturing clients that need logistics.
why.rural_wage_nonagri: Wage levels drive the cost of drivers, loaders and warehouse labour.
why.cpi_inflation_general: Inflation pushes up fuel, wage and rent costs.
why.leads_2025_tier: LEADS is the government's own rating of state logistics policy, infrastructure and services.
why.brap_2024_category: A better reform rating means quicker warehouse licences, permits and inspections.
why.brap_2024_top_achiever_areas: Top-rated reform areas (e.g. land, construction permits, utilities) speed up warehouse set-up.
why.epi_2024_score: Export preparedness signals trade facilitation and export volumes that generate freight.

healthcare.label: Healthcare
healthcare.target_note: Health GVA is not separable by state in the handbook; ranking only.

why.per_capita_nsdp_real: Higher incomes mean more patients able to pay for private care.
why.mpce_urban: Urban household spending shows what city patients can afford.
why.mpce_rural: Rural household spending shows affordability across the wider catchment.
why.population_derived: A larger population means a larger patient base.
why.govt_beds_per_lakh_pop: Where public hospitals have fewer beds per person, more patients turn to private providers.
why.power_shortage_pct: ICUs, operating theatres and imaging cannot tolerate power cuts.
why.per_capita_power_availability: Grid capacity matters for power-hungry equipment such as MRI and dialysis.
why.momentum_services: Services growth (a broad proxy that includes health) signals rising demand for care.
why.specialists_per_lakh_pop: Specialists in public service indicate the pool of specialist doctors to recruit from.
why.phc_doctors_per_lakh_pop: Doctors in public service indicate the state's supply of medical graduates.
why.cpi_inflation_housing_urban: Rising urban rents raise the cost of clinic and hospital premises.
why.cpi_inflation_general: Inflation raises the cost of drugs, consumables and salaries.
why.edu_diploma_pct: Nursing, lab and paramedical staff mostly hold diplomas or certificates.
why.brap_2024_category: A better reform rating means quicker building, fire and pollution clearances for facilities.
why.brap_2024_top_achiever_areas: Top-rated reform areas (e.g. construction permits, environment, utilities) speed up hospital set-up.

hospitality.label: Hospitality
hospitality.target_note: Hotels & restaurants GVA is bundled with trade; tourism visits give demand context only.

why.domestic_tourist_visits: Domestic visitors are the core of hotel and restaurant demand.
why.foreign_tourist_visits: Foreign visitors bring higher room rates and longer stays.
why.mpce_urban: Urban household spending drives local dining and leisure demand.
why.nh_km_per_lakh_pop: Highways bring road-trip and weekend travellers.
why.rail_km_per_lakh_pop: Rail access brings budget and mid-market travellers.
why.momentum_services: Services growth (a broad proxy that includes hotels) signals rising activity.
why.ur_urban_us_adj: Front-desk, kitchen and service staff are hired from the urban job-seeker pool.
why.cpi_inflation_housing_urban: Rising urban rents raise property and lease costs.
why.cpi_inflation_general: Inflation raises food and operating costs.
why.edu_secondary_plus_pct: Front-office and guest-facing roles are usually filled with at least secondary schooling.
why.brap_2024_category: A better reform rating means quicker hotel, food-safety and liquor licences.
why.brap_2024_top_achiever_areas: Top-rated reform areas (e.g. services sector, construction permits) speed up openings.

power_intensive.why: You flagged power-intensive operations: supply reliability decides uptime.

digital_first.why: You flagged a digital-first model: customers and staff need to be online.

logistics_heavy.why: You flagged logistics-heavy operations: transport links set delivery time and cost.

skilled_labour.why: You flagged skilled-labour needs: the depth of the relevant talent pool matters more.
